description: Parse a firearm or ammunition product title from any store into structured data: firearm or ammo, brand, model (50 brands, e.g. 'Glock 19 Gen 5 MOS'), calibers, magazine capacity, barrel length in inches, rounds per box and, with a price, cost per round. Also returns GunsNPrices pages to compare current prices.

brand.description: Manufacturer, if known (helps when the title doesn't name it)

price.description: Listing price in USD; for ammo it gives cost per round

title.description: Product title as a store shows it, e.g. 'Glock 19 Gen5 MOS 9mm 4.02in 15rd'

name: parse_product_title
title: Parse a gun or ammo product title
